usedFor: Userflow knows your new users, and Conversion Chats messages them when “User Created” runs “Send Template Message”.

bestTemplate.name: “User Created” in Userflow, then “Send Template Message” in Conversion Chats
bestTemplate.why: A new user gets a welcome template message, sent through your Conversion Chats account.

watchOut: A message that reaches someone outside waits in Needs you for your approval before “Send Template Message” goes out.
